description: Decentralised-finance mechanics tied to the library: lending-protocol interest indices as periodic compounding against the zero-coupon bond, liquidation as a structural default, constant-product and concentrated-liquidity positions against option payoffs and the lognormal model. Fees, gas and block timing are not modelled. `chapter` is not used; each entry's `reference` names its source.
alignment_source: Several works: each entry's `reference` names its source (textbooks, papers and regulatory texts in mathematical finance)

theorems.name: Compound Interest-Rate Index Against Continuous Compounding
theorems.description: Compound's interest-rate index Index_n = Index_{n-1} * (1 + r*t), at a constant per-block rate r over periods of t blocks, with r*t >= -1 and a nonnegative initial index, never exceeds continuous compounding over the elapsed time: Index_n <= Index_0 / zcb(r, 0, n*t) = Index_0 * exp(r*n*t). Splitting a horizon T into n equal periods, Index_0 * (1 + r*T/n)^n converges to Index_0 / zcb(r, 0, T). Rates that change between periods are not covered.

code.lean:
import MathFin.DeFi.Compound

open MathFin MathFin.DeFi.Compound Filter Topology

/-- Compound's interest-rate index at a constant rate never out-accrues continuous compounding
over the elapsed time, and accruing a horizon in ever more periods converges to it. -/
theorem compound_borrow_index_vs_continuous (index : ℕ → ℝ) {r t : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ index 0)
    (hrt : -1 ≤ r * t) (hrec : ∀ n, index (n + 1) = index n * (1 + r * t)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, index n ≤ index 0 * (zcb r 0 (n * t))⁻¹) ∧
      ∀ T : ℝ, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ index 0 * (1 + r * (T / n)) ^ n) atTop
        (𝓝 (index 0 * (zcb r 0 T)⁻¹)) :=
  ⟨borrowIndex_le_inv_zcb index h0 hrt hrec, fun T ↦ tendsto_borrowIndex (index 0) r T⟩

metadata.reference: R. Leshner and G. Hayes, Compound: The Money Market Protocol, v1.0 (February 2019), §3.2.1 Market Dynamics (Index_{a,n} = Index_{a,(n-1)} * (1 + r * t)); J. C. Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives, §4.2 (continuous compounding)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.DeFi.Compound.borrowIndex_le_inv_zcb and MathFin.DeFi.Compound.tendsto_borrowIndex (MathFin/DeFi/Compound.lean), which instantiate MathFin.one_add_mul_pow_le_inv_zcb and MathFin.tendsto_one_add_div_pow_inv_zcb (MathFin/FixedIncome/PeriodicCompounding.lean) against the library's zero-coupon bond zcb (MathFin/FixedIncome/ZCB.lean). SCOPE: constant rate only; the index recurrence is a hypothesis, as in the whitepaper; the limit is Mathlib's (1 + t/n)^n -> exp t. Per-block rates that change with utilization, and the reserve-factor split, are not covered.

theorems.name: Dai Stability-Fee Compounding Is Continuous Compounding
theorems.description: If a Dai vault's debt compounds at a per-period stability fee fee > -1, debt(n+1) = debt(n) * (1 + fee), then the debt after n periods discounted by the zero-coupon bond at the continuously compounded rate log(1 + fee), zcb(log(1 + fee), 0, n), equals the initial debt: per-period compounding at fee is continuous compounding at log(1 + fee), with time measured in periods.

code.lean:
import MathFin.DeFi.Dai

open MathFin

/-- Per-period stability-fee compounding, discounted at the continuously compounded rate
`log (1 + fee)`, returns the initial debt. -/
theorem dai_stability_fee_continuous_rate (debt : ℕ → ℝ) {fee : ℝ} (hfee : -1 < fee)
    (hrec : ∀ n, debt (n + 1) = debt n * (1 + fee)) (n : ℕ) :
    debt n * zcb (Real.log (1 + fee)) 0 n = debt 0 :=
  MathFin.DeFi.Dai.debt_mul_zcb_log_eq debt hfee hrec n

metadata.reference: MakerDAO, The Maker Protocol: MakerDAO's Multi-Collateral Dai (MCD) System (2020), risk parameter 'Stability Fee'; MakerDAO technical documentation, Rates Module (Jug: per-second rate compounded over elapsed seconds by drip); J. C. Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives, §4.2 (continuous compounding)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.DeFi.Dai.debt_mul_zcb_log_eq (MathFin/DeFi/Dai.lean), which applies MathFin.one_add_pow_mul_zcb_log (MathFin/FixedIncome/PeriodicCompounding.lean) to the closed form debt n = debt 0 * (1 + fee)^n. SCOPE: the per-period fee is constant and the compounding recurrence is a hypothesis; a period is any unit (a second for the MCD Jug). Fixed-point rounding of the on-chain rpow is not modelled.

theorems.name: Aave Health-Factor Liquidation Probability at a Horizon
theorems.description: If the collateral value at T is lognormal, C_T = C_0 * exp((mu - sigma^2/2) T + sigma sqrt(T) Z) with Z standard normal (BSCallHyp, rate slot read as the drift mu), and the liquidation threshold LT > 0 and the total debt borrows + fees > 0 are fixed, then the probability that the Aave single-asset health factor C_T * LT / (borrows + fees) is below 1 at T equals the Merton/KMV default probability kmvPD = Phi(-d2) with default barrier (borrows + fees) / LT. A check at the single date T: the probability of a first passage below the threshold before T is not derived; one risky collateral asset.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Bridges.LiquidationAsStructuralDefault

open MathFin MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

/-- The probability that an Aave health factor is below one at the horizon, for lognormal
collateral, is the Merton–KMV default probability with barrier `(borrows + fees) / LT`. -/
theorem aave_health_factor_liquidation_probability {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {C_0 LT B F μ σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (hdebt : 0 < B + F) (hLT : 0 < LT) (h : BSCallHyp Q C_0 ((B + F) / LT) μ σ T Z) :
    (Q {ω | MathFin.DeFi.Aave.healthFactorV1 (bsTerminal C_0 μ σ T (Z ω)) LT B F < 1}).toReal
      = kmvPD C_0 ((B + F) / LT) μ σ T :=
  prob_healthFactorV1_lt_one_eq_kmvPD hdebt hLT h

metadata.reference: Aave, Aave Protocol V2 whitepaper (2020), §5 Formal Definitions (health factor; HF < 1 can be liquidated); R. C. Merton, On the pricing of corporate debt: the risk structure of interest rates, J. Finance 29 (1974) 449-470
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.prob_healthFactorV1_lt_one_eq_kmvPD (MathFin/Bridges/LiquidationAsStructuralDefault.lean): the liquidation set {HF < 1} is rewritten to {C_T < (B+F)/LT} (MathFin.DeFi.Aave.healthFactorV1_lt_one_iff) and its probability computed by MathFin.prob_bsTerminal_lt_eq_kmvPD (the strict shortfall region z < -d2, the standard normal's null singletons, Phi_def, kmvDistanceToDefault_eq_bsd2). SCOPE: terminal check at T only (protocols liquidate at the first crossing, a first-passage probability not computed here); debt and fees fixed at T; single collateral asset; the multi-asset healthFactorV2 is not covered.

theorems.name: Constant-Product Impermanent Loss Is Nonpositive
theorems.description: For a fee-free constant-product pool with deposit (x0, y0) and a price move by the factor r > 0, the LP-to-HODL value ratio minus one, computed from the rebalanced reserves, equals IL(r) = 2 sqrt(r)/(1 + r) - 1 = -(sqrt(r) - 1)^2/(1 + r); hence IL(r) <= 0, with IL(r) = 0 if and only if r = 1. Fees are not modelled.

code.lean:
import MathFin.DeFi.UniswapMechanics

open MathFin.DeFi

/-- The constant-product impermanent loss, derived from the rebalanced reserves, is
`−(√r − 1)²/(1 + r)`: never positive, and zero exactly when the price returns. -/
theorem cpmm_impermanent_loss_nonpos {x0 y0 r : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x0) (hy0 : 0 < y0) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (impermanentLossReservesX x0 y0 r * (r * y0 / x0) + impermanentLossReservesY x0 y0 r)
          / (x0 * (r * y0 / x0) + y0) - 1 = impermanentLoss r ∧
      impermanentLoss r = -(Real.sqrt r - 1) ^ 2 / (1 + r) ∧
      impermanentLoss r ≤ 0 ∧ (impermanentLoss r = 0 ↔ r = 1) :=
  ⟨impermanentLoss_eq x0 y0 r hx0 hy0 hr, impermanentLoss_eq_neg_sq hr.le,
    impermanentLoss_nonpos hr.le, impermanentLoss_eq_zero_iff hr.le⟩

metadata.reference: L. Heimbach, E. Schertenleib, R. Wattenhofer, Risks and Returns of Uniswap V3 Liquidity Providers, Proc. 4th ACM Conference on Advances in Financial Technologies (AFT 2022), arXiv:2205.08904 (impermanent loss of a constant-product position, the v2 formula as the full-range case)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.DeFi.impermanentLoss_eq, impermanentLoss_eq_neg_sq, impermanentLoss_nonpos and impermanentLoss_eq_zero_iff (MathFin/DeFi/UniswapMechanics.lean). The rebalanced reserves satisfy both the invariant and the new-price equation (impermanentLossReserves_invariant, impermanentLossReserves_price); the sign is AM-GM, 2 sqrt r <= 1 + r, via sqrt(r)^2 = r. SCOPE: fee-free pool at the external price; that the rebalanced reserves are the only positive solution is not stated.

theorems.name: Uniswap v3 Position Value as a Covered Call
theorems.description: For a Uniswap v3 position with liquidity L >= 0 on the square-root price range [a, b] (0 < a < b), its value in token Y at square-root price s >= 0 (all token X below the range, the real reserves inside, all token Y above) is all X at s = a and all Y at s = b; it equals the covered-call payoff x_max * (s^2 - max(s^2 - ab, 0)) (long the full X holding x_max, short a call struck at sqrt(p_a p_b) = ab) outside the range, is at most that payoff everywhere, and inside the range falls short of it by exactly min(L (s - a)^2 / a, L (b - s)^2 / b). Fees are not modelled.

code.lean:
import MathFin.DeFi.UniswapMechanics

open MathFin.DeFi

/-- A Uniswap v3 range position is a covered call struck at the geometric-mean price, less a
smoothing term inside the range. -/
theorem uniswap_v3_position_covered_call {L a b s : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    v3PositionValue L a b a = a ^ 2 * realReserveX L a b ∧
      v3PositionValue L a b b = realReserveY L b a ∧
      (s ≤ a ∨ b < s →
        v3PositionValue L a b s = realReserveX L a b * (s ^ 2 - max (s ^ 2 - a * b) 0)) ∧
      v3PositionValue L a b s ≤ realReserveX L a b * (s ^ 2 - max (s ^ 2 - a * b) 0) ∧
      (a < s → s ≤ b →
        realReserveX L a b * (s ^ 2 - max (s ^ 2 - a * b) 0) - v3PositionValue L a b s
          = min (L * (s - a) ^ 2 / a) (L * (b - s) ^ 2 / b)) :=
  ⟨v3PositionValue_at_lower L a b, v3PositionValue_at_upper L hab,
    fun h ↦ h.elim (v3PositionValue_eq_coveredCall_of_le ha hab.le hs)
      (v3PositionValue_eq_coveredCall_of_lt ha hab.le),
    v3PositionValue_le_coveredCall hL ha hab.le hs,
    fun has hsb ↦ coveredCall_sub_v3PositionValue hL ha has hsb⟩

metadata.reference: H. Adams, N. Zinsmeister, M. Salem, R. Keefer, D. Robinson, Uniswap v3 Core (2021), §2 (eq. 2.2, real reserves) and §6.4.1 (eqs. 6.29-6.30, token amounts below, inside and above the range)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.DeFi.v3PositionValue_at_lower, v3PositionValue_at_upper, v3PositionValue_eq_coveredCall_of_le, v3PositionValue_eq_coveredCall_of_lt, v3PositionValue_le_coveredCall and coveredCall_sub_v3PositionValue (MathFin/DeFi/UniswapMechanics.lean). The value is defined from the v3 reserve formulas realReserveX/realReserveY in the three price regimes; the in-range gaps come from two algebraic identities (realReserveX_mul_sq_sub_inRange, realReserveX_mul_mul_sub_inRange). SCOPE: values in token Y at a given price; fees, ticks and the pricing of the call are not modelled.

theorems.name: Expected Constant-Product LP Value Under a Lognormal Price
theorems.description: For a fee-free constant-product pool kept at the external price, with deposit (x0, y0) at the pool price and a driftless lognormal price move r_T = exp(-sigma^2 T/2 + sigma sqrt(T) Z), Z standard normal (BSCallHyp with zero drift), the expected value of the LP position at T is exp(-sigma^2 T/8) times the expected value of holding the deposit. Values are in token Y and undiscounted; fees and the arbitrage path are not modelled.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Bridges.ConstantProductLPLognormal

open MathFin MathFin.DeFi MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

/-- Under a driftless lognormal price move, the expected constant-product LP value is
`exp (−σ² T / 8)` times the expected buy-and-hold value. -/
theorem cpmm_lp_expected_value_lognormal {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {Q : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {x0 y0 K σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x0) (hy0 : 0 < y0)
    (h : BSCallHyp Q 1 K 0 σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, (impermanentLossReservesX x0 y0 (bsTerminal 1 0 σ T (Z ω))
          * (bsTerminal 1 0 σ T (Z ω) * y0 / x0)
        + impermanentLossReservesY x0 y0 (bsTerminal 1 0 σ T (Z ω))) ∂Q
      = Real.exp (-(σ ^ 2 * T / 8))
        * ∫ ω, (x0 * (bsTerminal 1 0 σ T (Z ω) * y0 / x0) + y0) ∂Q :=
  integral_lpValue_eq_exp_mul_integral_hodlValue hx0 hy0 h

metadata.reference: G. Angeris, H.-T. Kao, R. Chiang, C. Noyes, T. Chitra, An analysis of Uniswap markets, Cryptoeconomic Systems 1(1) (2021); J. Milionis, C. C. Moallemi, T. Roughgarden, A. L. Zhang, Automated Market Making and Loss-Versus-Rebalancing (2022), arXiv:2208.06046 (constant-product rate sigma^2/8)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.integral_lpValue_eq_exp_mul_integral_hodlValue (MathFin/Bridges/ConstantProductLPLognormal.lean): the LP value is 2 y0 sqrt(r) (MathFin.DeFi.lpPortfolioValue_eq), sqrt of a lognormal factor is lognormal with half the volatility (sqrt_bsTerminal_one, Real.exp_half), and both expectations are the library's forward identity expected_terminal_eq_forward (MathFin/BlackScholes/Forward.lean); the general-drift formula E[LP_T] = 2 y0 exp((mu/2 - sigma^2/8) T) is integral_lpValue_lognormal. SCOPE: fee-free pool assumed at the external price at T; deposit at the pool price; values in token Y, undiscounted; fees and the path of arbitrage trades are not modelled.

theorems.name: Constant-Product Arbitrage Exists Iff the Pool Price Diverges
theorems.description: For a fee-free constant-product pool with reserves x, y > 0 and an external price P > 0, the pool's internal price y/x differs from P if and only if some single swap against the pool, valued at P, earns a riskless profit, by selling X to the pool or buying X from it (which direction pays, selling when P < y/x and buying when y/x < P, is exists_profitable_swap_iff / exists_profitable_reverse_swap_iff, not this statement). Equivalently, a pool at the external price admits no profitable swap of any size. Fees are not modelled.

code.lean:
import MathFin.DeFi.ConstantProductAMM

open MathFin.DeFi

/-- The internal price `y / x` differs from the external price `P` exactly when some single swap
against the pool, valued at `P`, earns a riskless profit. -/
theorem cpmm_arbitrage_iff_price_divergence {x y P : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hP : 0 < P) :
    arbitragePresent x y P ↔
      (∃ Δx > 0, P * Δx < swapOutput x y Δx) ∨ (∃ Δy > 0, Δy < P * swapOutput y x Δy) :=
  arbitragePresent_iff hx hy hP

metadata.reference: G. Angeris, H.-T. Kao, R. Chiang, C. Noyes, T. Chitra, An analysis of Uniswap markets, Cryptoeconomic Systems 1(1) (2021), §2.1 (optimal arbitrage; no-arbitrage bound (3), which at zero fee says the pool price equals the reference price)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.DeFi.arbitragePresent_iff (MathFin/DeFi/ConstantProductAMM.lean), from exists_profitable_swap_iff and exists_profitable_reverse_swap_iff: a swap of size D > 0 is profitable iff P (x + D) < y (resp. y + D < P x), and such a D exists iff P x < y (resp. y < P x). arbitragePresent is defined as internalPrice x y ≠ P. SCOPE: fee-free pool, one swap at a time; the optimal arbitrage size and the fee band of Angeris et al. are not formalized.

theorems.name: Black-Scholes Price Bound for a Uniswap v3 Position
theorems.description: If the price of X in Y is lognormal under Q (BSCallHyp with rate r, volatility sigma, strike slot ab), the discounted expected value at T of a Uniswap v3 position with liquidity L >= 0 on the square-root price range [a, b] (0 < a <= b), held without fees, is at most x_max * (S_0 - C), where x_max is the position's full X holding and C = S_0 Phi(d1) - ab e^{-rT} Phi(d2) is the Black-Scholes call struck at the geometric-mean price ab = sqrt(p_a p_b). An upper bound only: the expectation of the in-range gap is not computed.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Bridges.UniswapV3CoveredCallPrice

open MathFin MathFin.DeFi MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

/-- The Black–Scholes value of a Uniswap v3 range position is at most that of the covered call
struck at the geometric-mean price of the range. -/
theorem uniswap_v3_position_bs_price_bound {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {S_0 r σ T L a b : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 (a * b) r σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * v3PositionValue L a b (Real.sqrt (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω))) ∂Q
      ≤ realReserveX L a b * (S_0 - (S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 (a * b) r σ T)
          - a * b * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 (a * b) r σ T))) :=
  integral_discounted_v3PositionValue_le hL ha hab h

metadata.reference: H. Adams, N. Zinsmeister, M. Salem, R. Keefer, D. Robinson, Uniswap v3 Core (2021), §6.4.1 (eqs. 6.29-6.30, position token amounts); F. Black and M. Scholes, The pricing of options and corporate liabilities, J. Political Economy 81 (1973) 637-654
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.integral_discounted_v3PositionValue_le (MathFin/Bridges/UniswapV3CoveredCallPrice.lean): the pointwise covered-call bound MathFin.DeFi.v3PositionValue_le_coveredCall at s = sqrt(S_T), integral_mono (the position value is measurable and bounded by x_max * ab), then discounted_terminal_eq_S0 (MathFin/BlackScholes/Forward.lean) and bs_call_formula (MathFin/BlackScholes/Call.lean). SCOPE: an upper bound, not the price; the position is held to T with no fees, no rebalancing and Y as the numeraire; the expected in-range gap is not computed.

theorems.name: Historical-Simulation VaR of a Uniswap v3 Concentrated-Liquidity Position
theorems.description: Historical-simulation VaR revalues a Uniswap v3 concentrated-liquidity position (liquidity L >= 0 on square-root price range [a, b], 0 < a <= b, marked today at square-root price s0) under n >= 1 historical square-root-price scenarios, each equally likely (weight 1/n), and reports the empirical alpha-quantile of the resulting loss distribution (alpha in (0, 1)). This VaR never exceeds the position's current mark-to-market value, since the position's value is always nonnegative, and scales linearly with the deployed liquidity: doubling L (same range and scenarios) doubles the VaR. Fees, re-ranging and multi-day return compounding (the horizon-scaling convention a genuine 99%/10-day VaR needs) are not modelled; the n historical scenarios are taken as given data, not derived from a price process.

code.lean:
import MathFin.DeFi.ConcentratedLiquidityVaR

open MathFin.DeFi MathFin.DiscreteVaR

/-- Historical-simulation VaR of a Uniswap v3 concentrated-liquidity position never exceeds
the position's current value, and scales linearly with the deployed liquidity. -/
theorem uniswap_v3_concentrated_liquidity_historical_var {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {L a b : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (s0 : ℝ) (scenarios : Fin n → ℝ) {α : ℝ}
    (hα : α ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    clHistoricalVaR L a b s0 hn scenarios α ≤ v3PositionValue L a b s0 ∧
      clHistoricalVaR (c * L) a b s0 hn scenarios α
        = c * clHistoricalVaR L a b s0 hn scenarios α :=
  ⟨clHistoricalVaR_le_value hn hL ha hab s0 scenarios hα.1 hα.2.le,
    clHistoricalVaR_smul_liquidity hn L a b s0 scenarios hα hc⟩

metadata.reference: H. Adams, N. Zinsmeister, M. Salem, R. Keefer, D. Robinson, Uniswap v3 Core (2021), §2, §6.4.1 (eqs. 6.29-6.30, position token amounts); P. Jorion, Value at Risk: The New Benchmark for Managing Financial Risk, 3rd ed. (2007), §12.2 (historical simulation)
metadata.formalization_scope: Full formal proof. Re-export of MathFin.DeFi.clHistoricalVaR_le_value and MathFin.DeFi.clHistoricalVaR_smul_liquidity (MathFin/DeFi/ConcentratedLiquidityVaR.lean). clHistoricalVaR is MathFin.DiscreteVaR.finiteVaR (RiskMeasures/DiscreteVaR.lean) of the per-scenario loss v3PositionValue L a b s0 - v3PositionValue L a b (scenarios i) at the uniform weight vector; the value-cap bound comes from v3PositionValue_nonneg plus the new general lemma MathFin.DiscreteVaR.finiteVaR_le_of_forall_le, and the homogeneity from the new v3PositionValue_smul_liquidity (v3PositionValue is literally linear in L) plus the new general lemma MathFin.DiscreteVaR.finiteVaR_const_mul (positive homogeneity of finiteVaR, derived from RiskMeasures/ValueAtRisk.lean's valueAtRisk_const_mul through the existing finiteVaR-valueAtRisk bridge). SCOPE: the risk measure applied to the position's deterministic value function at n given scenarios; no fee model, no re-ranging, and no horizon-scaling theorem for turning 1-day scenarios into a 10-day VaR.
